title: Polish Vegetable Stew
description: A hearty and earthy Polish-inspired vegetable stew made with crisp vegetables and served with a side of stew
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until softened.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until browned.
Add the chopped cabbage and carrots, cook for 5 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes, tomato paste, and vegetable broth.
Stir in the stew seasoning and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve hot with a side of Polish rye bread.
